name: Valverde de Leganés (Spain)
description: Square flag horizontally divided white over green in the proportions 3:1, charged on the white with the crowned municipal arms of Valverde de Leganés (a purple lion on white per chevron green).
history: Municipal flag of Valverde de Leganés; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Valverde de Leganés arms — lion on white, per chevron green
